items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: I heard of him. No, I heard of him.

ctx.x: Did you know Omar Simeo? Clarinet player, a colored clarinet player? He used to work with Jolly Roll?
I heard of him. No, I heard of him. But you don't remember him.
And Marvin Saxby, did you ever know? Yeah. Oh, man, he's a good friend.
